items.question: James decides to build a tin house by collecting 500 tins in a week. On the first day, he collects 50 tins. On the second day, he manages to collect 3 times that number. On the third day, he collects 50 tins fewer than the number he collected on the second day. If he collects an equal number of tins on the remaining days of the week, what's the number of tins he collected each day for the rest of the week?
John buys 3 puzzles.  The first puzzle has 1000 pieces.  The second and third puzzles have the same number of pieces and each has 50% more pieces.  How many total pieces are all the puzzles?

previous_f3_program: collection("john.purchased_puzzles", "puzzle", "john", source("John buys 3 puzzles"))
add("buy_puzzles", "john", at("john.purchased_puzzles.count", "current"), 3, source("John buys 3 puzzles"))

collection("john.purchased_puzzles.piece_counts", "piece_count", "john.purchased_puzzles", source("The first puzzle has 1000 pieces.  The second and third puzzles have the same number of pieces and each has 50% more pieces"))
member("john.purchased_puzzles.piece_counts", "john.purchased_puzzles.first.pieces.count", source("The first puzzle has 1000 pieces"))
member("john.purchased_puzzles.piece_counts", "john.purchased_puzzles.second.pieces.count", source("The second and third puzzles have the same number of pieces"))
member("john.purchased_puzzles.piece_counts", "john.purchased_puzzles.third.pieces.count", source("The second and third puzzles have the same number of pieces"))
observe(at("john.purchased_puzzles.first.pieces.count", "current"), 1000, "count", source("The first puzzle has 1000 pieces"))
same(at("john.purchased_puzzles.second.pieces.count", "current"), at("john.purchased_puzzles.third.pieces.count", "current"), source("The second and third puzzles have the same number of pieces"))
percent_more(at("john.purchased_puzzles.second.pieces.count", "current"), at("john.purchased_puzzles.first.pieces.count", "current"), 50, source("each has 50% more pieces"))
percent_more(at("john.purchased_puzzles.third.pieces.count", "current"), at("john.purchased_puzzles.first.pieces.count", "current"), 50, source("each has 50% more pieces"))
query("sum", "john.purchased_puzzles.piece_counts", "current")

items.question: There is very little car traffic on Happy Street. During the week, most cars pass it on Tuesday - 25. On Monday, 20% less than on Tuesday, and on Wednesday, 2 more cars than on Monday. On Thursday and Friday, it is about 10 cars each day. On the weekend, traffic drops to 5 cars per day. How many cars travel down Happy Street from Monday through Sunday?

Studying for her test, Mitchell had read ten chapters of a book before 4 o'clock. When it clocked 4, Mitchell had read 20 pages of the 11th chapter of the book she was studying from. After 4 o'clock, she didn't read the remaining pages of chapter eleven but proceeded and read 2 more chapters of the book. If each chapter in the book had 40 pages, calculate the total number of pages that Mitchell had read altogether?

previous_f3_program: collection("mitchell.book.pages_read_components", "page_count", "mitchell.book", source("the total number of pages that Mitchell had read altogether"))
observe(at("mitchell.book.full_chapters_read.count", "before_4_oclock"), 10, "count", source("Mitchell had read ten chapters of a book before 4 o'clock"))
observe(at("mitchell.book.chapter_11.pages_read.count", "4_oclock"), 20, "count", source("Mitchell had read 20 pages of the 11th chapter"))

same(at("mitchell.book.chapter_11.pages_read.count", "current"), at("mitchell.book.chapter_11.pages_read.count", "4_oclock"), source("After 4 o'clock, she didn't read the remaining pages of chapter eleven"))
add("read_two_more_chapters", "mitchell", at("mitchell.book.full_chapters_read.count", "current"), 2, source("read 2 more chapters of the book"))
observe(at("mitchell.book.pages_per_chapter", "current"), 40, "page_per_chapter", source("each chapter in the book had 40 pages"))

rate_relation(at("mitchell.book.full_chapters_read.pages.count", "current"), at("mitchell.book.pages_per_chapter", "current"), at("mitchell.book.full_chapters_read.count", "current"), source("each chapter in the book had 40 pages"))
member("mitchell.book.pages_read_components", "mitchell.book.full_chapters_read.pages.count", source("Mitchell had read ten chapters of a book before 4 o'clock"))
member("mitchell.book.pages_read_components", "mitchell.book.chapter_11.pages_read.count", source("Mitchell had read 20 pages of the 11th chapter"))
query("sum", "mitchell.book.pages_read_components", "current")

items.question: Ariana is past due on three bills. The first bill for $200 charges 10% simple interest for each overdue month and it's 2 months overdue. The second bill for $130 charges a flat $50 late fee per month and is 6 months overdue. The last bill is two months late and charges a $40 fee the first month overdue and twice that fee the second month overdue and is for $444. How much does Ariana owe in total?

previous_f3_program: collection("ariana.bills", "bill", "ariana", source("Ariana is past due on three bills"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("Ariana is past due on three bills"))
member("ariana.bills", "ariana.bills.first", source("The first bill"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.first.balance", "initial"), 200, "currency", source("The first bill for $200"))
percent_of(at("ariana.bills.first.simple_interest.per_month.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.first.balance", "initial"), 10, source("charges 10% simple interest for each overdue month"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.first.overdue_duration", "current"), 2, "month", source("it's 2 months overdue"))

rate_relation(at("ariana.bills.first.simple_interest.total.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.first.simple_interest.per_month.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.first.overdue_duration", "current"), source("charges 10% simple interest for each overdue month and it's 2 months overdue"))

add("first_bill_interest_charge", "ariana.bills.first", at("ariana.bills.first.balance", "current"), at("ariana.bills.first.simple_interest.total.amount", "current"), source("The first bill for $200 charges 10% simple interest for each overdue month and it's 2 months overdue"))
member("ariana.bills", "ariana.bills.second", source("The second bill"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.second.balance", "initial"), 130, "currency", source("The second bill for $130"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.second.late_fee.per_month.amount", "current"), 50, "currency_per_month", source("charges a flat $50 late fee per month"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.second.overdue_duration", "current"), 6, "month", source("is 6 months overdue"))

rate_relation(at("ariana.bills.second.late_fee.total.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.second.late_fee.per_month.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.second.overdue_duration", "current"), source("charges a flat $50 late fee per month and is 6 months overdue"))

add("second_bill_late_fee_charge", "ariana.bills.second", at("ariana.bills.second.balance", "current"), at("ariana.bills.second.late_fee.total.amount", "current"), source("The second bill for $130 charges a flat $50 late fee per month and is 6 months overdue"))
member("ariana.bills", "ariana.bills.last", source("The last bill"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.last.balance", "initial"), 444, "currency", source("is for $444"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.last.overdue_duration", "current"), 2, "month", source("The last bill is two months late"))
add("last_bill_first_month_fee", "ariana.bills.last", at("ariana.bills.last.balance", "current"), 40, source("charges a $40 fee the first month overdue"))

add("last_bill_second_month_fee", "ariana.bills.last", at("ariana.bills.last.balance", "current"), scale(event_field("last_bill_first_month_fee", "quantity"), 2), source("twice that fee the second month overdue"))
query("sum", "ariana.bills", "current")
